stances_toward.note: Member inside a quota it keeps hitting rather than a producer choosing its own volume: OPEC data cited by Nairametrics (13 October 2026) show 1.50 million bpd in August and 1.53 million bpd in September against the 1.5 million quota, compliance for five straight months, the quota extended to December 2026. Partner on the Kuwait card's model (OPEC member graded partner/stable/none). The friction is domestic: the budget assumes 1.84 million bpd including condensates and Nigeria is below it, so the quota is not the binding constraint, capacity is. The UAE left the bloc on 1 May 2026 (UAE card), which makes quota discipline a live question. Membership date from the Wikidata membership row (dataset).

relations_to.summary: Angola joined OPEC in 2007 and left it on 1 January 2024, announced on 21 December 2023, after a quota dispute: OPEC+ set its 2024 target at 1.11m barrels a day against the 1.18m it had asked for. The oil minister said continued membership was no longer in the country's best interests.

relations_to.summary: Nigeria kept to its OPEC production quota of 1.5 million bpd for five straight months to September 2026: 1.50 million bpd in August and 1.53 million bpd in September per OPEC data (Q3 average 1.512 million, Q2 1.525 million, Q1 1.388 million); the quota was extended to December 2026. The 2026 budget assumes 1.84 million bpd including condensates, which NUPRC counted at about 1.7 million in September.
